metadata.title: Robot SF 14-planner S30/H600 benchmark dataset
metadata.description: Benchmark-data snapshot for Robot SF covering 14 planner arms, 48 social-navigation scenarios, and 30 seeds at horizon 600 with dt=0.1 and differential-drive kinematics (20,160 expected episode identities). The archive preserves raw episode and component-metric evidence with exact source provenance: source commit {{source_sha}}, mainline base {{latest_main_base_commit}}, release tag {{release_tag}}, concept DOI {{concept_doi}}, and version DOI {{version_doi}}. The Social Navigation Quality Index (SNQI) is advisory only because calibration failed; this release makes no SNQI ranking claim.
